en.impact: Nothing was cancelled; the 1 run already used is not refunded, and existing progress and results stay as they are
en.message: This run has already started, so it cannot be withdrawn with “cancel before start”
en.next: You can let it continue, or delete this run using the action on the page

zh.impact: 没有取消；已经用掉的 1 次机会不退，已有的进度与结果保持不变
zh.message: 这次运行已经开始过，不能按“开始前取消”撤回
zh.next: 可以等它接着运行，或者按页面上的动作删除这次运行

en.impact: This change was not made
en.message: The request is missing the page check code, or it is wrong
en.next: Refresh the page and try again

zh.impact: 这次修改没有被执行
zh.message: 请求缺少或带错了页面校验码
zh.next: 刷新页面后再试

en.impact: No simulation was started and no run was used
en.message: The city data pack this run needs is unavailable right now, or differs from the recorded version
en.next: Try again later; the maintainer will check the data pack

zh.impact: 没有开始模拟，也没有使用次数
zh.message: 运行需要的城市资料包现在不可用或与记录的版本不同
zh.next: 稍后再试；维护者会核对资料包

en.impact: The content can no longer be viewed or restored; deleting does not reset the number of runs used
en.message: This content has been deleted
en.next: Create it again if you need it

zh.impact: 内容不能再查看或恢复；删除不会重置使用次数
zh.message: 这项内容已经删除
zh.next: 需要的话重新创建

en.impact: The content can no longer be viewed and is being wound down safely
en.message: This run is being deleted
en.next: Refresh later; it cannot be restored once deletion completes

zh.impact: 内容已经不可查看，正在安全收尾
zh.message: 这次运行正在删除
zh.next: 稍后刷新；删除完成后不能恢复

en.impact: The content can no longer be viewed or used; viewing or refreshing does not extend it
en.message: This content is past its retention period
en.next: Create it again if you need it

zh.impact: 内容已经不能查看或使用；查看、刷新都不续期
zh.message: 这项内容已经超过保存期限
zh.next: 需要的话重新创建

en.impact: This request was not carried out
en.message: This request ID has already been used for a different request
en.next: Generate a new request ID for a new request; when resending the same request, keep its content unchanged

zh.impact: 这次请求没有被执行
zh.message: 这个请求编号已经用于另一份不同的请求
zh.next: 为新的请求生成新的请求编号；重发同一个请求时请保持内容不变

en.impact: No new run intent was created
en.message: You already have a simulation being prepared or in progress, with different conditions
en.next: Finish, cancel or delete that one first, then start with the new conditions

zh.impact: 没有创建新的运行意图
zh.message: 你已经有一次正在准备或进行中的模拟，条件与这次不同
zh.next: 先完成、取消或删除那一次，再用新的条件开始

en.impact: This request did not complete
en.message: The service hit an internal problem
en.next: Try again later; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference

zh.impact: 这次请求没有完成
zh.message: 服务出现了内部问题
zh.next: 稍后再试；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

en.impact: This request was not carried out
en.message: The request's format or content does not meet the requirements
en.next: Check what you entered on the page; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference

zh.impact: 这次请求没有被执行
zh.message: 请求的格式或内容不符合要求
zh.next: 检查页面上的填写；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

en.impact: This ID does not exist in your space (it may also have expired or been deleted)
en.message: This content was not found
en.next: Go back to “My runs” or create it again

zh.impact: 这个编号在你的空间里不存在（也可能已经过期或删除）
zh.message: 没有找到这项内容
zh.next: 回到“我的运行”或重新创建

en.impact: No new model request was sent and the run was not changed
en.message: You cannot resume this run right now
en.next: If the page says it is waiting for the maintainer, you do not need to fill anything in again; otherwise check the run's status

zh.impact: 没有发出新的模型请求，也没有改变运行
zh.message: 这次运行现在不能由你恢复
zh.next: 如果页面说在等维护者处理，你不需要重新填写；否则查看运行状态

en.impact: This change was not made
en.message: The request was not sent from this site's pages
en.next: Do it again from this site's pages

zh.impact: 这次修改没有被执行
zh.message: 请求不是从本站页面发出的
zh.next: 从本站页面重新操作

en.impact: A simulation that needs a real model cannot start, and the system will not quietly switch to the offline planner
en.message: The service has not turned on paid model calls
en.next: Try again after the service turns them on; no run was used

zh.impact: 不能开始需要真实模型的模拟，系统不会悄悄换成离线规划器
zh.message: 服务现在没有开启付费模型调用
zh.next: 等服务开启后再试；没有使用次数

en.impact: This request was not carried out
en.message: The request is too large
en.next: Shorten what you entered and try again

zh.impact: 这次请求没有被执行
zh.message: 请求内容太大
zh.next: 缩短填写内容后再试

en.impact: No simulation was started and no run was used
en.message: What you confirmed is not the current pre-run summary (the conditions or data changed, or the summary was updated)
en.next: Read the latest pre-run summary, then confirm again

zh.impact: 没有开始模拟，也没有使用次数
zh.message: 你确认的不是当前这一份运行前说明（条件或资料变了，或说明已经更新）
zh.next: 查看最新的运行前说明后再确认

en.impact: No new simulation can be started
en.message: This space's 3 simulation runs are used up or all in use
en.next: Look at the results you already have; the count does not reset automatically

zh.impact: 不能再开始新的模拟
zh.message: 这个空间的 3 次模拟机会已经用完或都在使用中
zh.next: 查看已有的运行结果；次数不会自动重置

en.impact: This request was not carried out
en.message: Too many requests
en.next: Wait a minute and try again

zh.impact: 这次请求没有被执行
zh.message: 请求太频繁
zh.next: 稍等一分钟再试

en.impact: There are no results before the start, after cancelling, while running or when stopped; nothing is made up when there are none
en.message: This run has no progress or results to view right now
en.next: Check this run's status; come back for the results after it ends

zh.impact: 还没有开始、已经取消、运行中或停下时没有结果；没有就不编一个
zh.message: 这次运行现在没有可以查看的进度或结果
zh.next: 查看这次运行的状态；结束后再来看结果

en.impact: This save was not written, and the newer answers were not overwritten
en.message: A newer version of this draft has already been saved elsewhere (for example in another tab)
en.next: Reload the latest draft, make your changes on top of it, then save

zh.impact: 这次保存没有写入，较新的答案没有被覆盖
zh.message: 这份草稿已经在别处（例如另一个标签页）保存了更新的版本
zh.next: 重新读取最新的草稿，在它的基础上修改后再保存

en.impact: No simulation was prepared and no run was used (field names which option)
en.message: The cities, clones per city, years or cost cap chosen this time are outside what the service allows
en.next: Choose again within the defaults and ranges in the service rules; cities are changed in the draft, followed by a new review and confirmation

zh.impact: 没有准备模拟，也没有使用次数（field 指出是哪一项）
zh.message: 这次选的城市、每城分身数、年数或费用上限不在服务允许的范围里
zh.next: 按服务规则里的默认值与允许范围重新选择；城市要在草稿里改，再重新审阅与确认

en.impact: The system will not continue with the service's current defaults instead; nothing was started and no run was used
en.message: The settings saved for this run, or its copy of the confirmed profile, are missing or damaged
en.next: Cancel this preparation and prepare again; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference

zh.impact: 系统不会改用服务现在的默认设置继续，没有开始，也没有使用次数
zh.message: 这次运行保存的设置或确认画像副本缺失、损坏
zh.next: 取消这次准备后重新准备；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

en.impact: Nothing in this space can be read or changed
en.message: There is no valid session, or your personal link is no longer valid
en.next: Open your personal link again; if the link was reissued, use the newest one

zh.impact: 不能读取或修改这个空间里的任何内容
zh.message: 没有有效的会话，或专属链接已经失效
zh.next: 重新打开你的专属链接；如果链接被重发过，请使用最新的那一个

en.impact: A draft is kept for the period in the service rules from its last edit, and viewing does not extend it; it can no longer be read, reviewed or confirmed
en.message: This draft is past its retention period
en.next: Start a new draft and fill it in again

zh.impact: 草稿从最后一次编辑起按服务规则保存，查看不续期；内容已经不能读取、审阅或确认
zh.message: 这份草稿已经超过保存期限
zh.next: 新建一份草稿重新填写

en.impact: A preparation that is awaiting confirmation, blocked by the pre-run check, paused or queued is kept for the period in the service rules from its last real action, and viewing does not extend it; nothing was started or continued, and no run was used
en.message: This simulation preparation is past its retention period
en.next: Prepare the simulation again if you need it

zh.impact: 等待确认、检查没通过、暂停或排队的准备从最后一次有效操作起按服务规则保存，查看不续期；没有开始或继续，也没有使用次数
zh.message: 这次模拟的准备已经超过保存期限
zh.next: 需要的话重新准备一次模拟

en.impact: A confirmed profile can prepare new simulations for the period in the service rules from its first confirmation; confirming again or viewing does not extend it; simulations already prepared use their own copy and deadline and are not affected
en.message: This confirmed profile can no longer be used to prepare new simulations
en.next: Review and confirm a draft that is still within its retention period, or start a new draft

zh.impact: 确认画像从首次确认起按服务规则可用，重复确认、查看都不续期；已经准备的模拟用自己的副本与期限，不受影响
zh.message: 这份确认画像已经超过可以准备新模拟的期限
zh.next: 重新审阅并确认还在保存期内的草稿，或新建草稿

en.impact: Results are kept for the period in the service rules from the run's first finish, and viewing does not extend it; the content can no longer be viewed
en.message: This run's results are past their retention period
en.next: Prepare a new simulation if you need it

zh.impact: 结果从运行首次结束起按服务规则保存，查看不续期；内容已经不能查看
zh.message: 这次运行的结果已经超过保存期限
zh.next: 需要的话重新准备一次模拟

en.impact: A review expires together with its draft and can no longer be used to confirm a profile
en.message: The draft this review belongs to is past its retention period
en.next: Start a new draft, fill it in and review it

zh.impact: 审阅跟着它的草稿一起到期，不能再用来确认画像
zh.message: 这份审阅所属的草稿已经超过保存期限
zh.next: 新建一份草稿重新填写并审阅

note: 固定双语错误目录（E3C 维护业务含义）。动态业务问题以服务回复里的显示附层为准，不要从中文反查
